name: Satya Bhargav Maddipati
summary: M.S. Computer Sciences student researching efficient language-model search, with interests in generative models for scientific data. Experience spans retrieval learning, time-series forecasting, model evaluation, and production ML systems.

education.title: M.S. in Computer Sciences

experience.title: Assistant Manager, Data Science (Software Engineer – ML); previously Management Trainee
bullets: Built and deployed FastAPI services on Azure for a customer-support platform serving 50K+ users; achieved 0.8 s p95 latency and 99.5% uptime.
Integrated LangGraph/CrewAI agent workflows into claims systems, reducing manual review effort by 35% (estimated 2,000+ person-hours annually).
Developed reusable fine-tuning pipelines for 5+ open-source LLMs using QLoRA/PEFT; document-classification accuracy improved from 78% to 94% on internal benchmarks.
Designed an embedding and collaborative-filtering recommendation service over 2M+ customer records and exposed it through REST APIs used by multiple internal teams.
experience.note: Management Trainee: July 2023 – June 2024; Assistant Manager, Data Science: June 2024 – December 2025

experience.title: Graduate Research Assistant
bullets: Built a time-series forecasting pipeline combining KZ filtering and multiple linear regression for detrending with SARIMA and grid-search-tuned Random Forest models on Sion CAAQMS air-quality data.

Evaluated raw and filtered inputs; SARIMA achieved PM2.5 RMSE of 0.44 at a 1-day horizon and 5.27 at 7 days. Applied SHAP to interpret the contributions of humidity, wind speed, and rainfall across pollutant targets.
experience.note: Time-series machine learning and model evaluation

research.title: Teacher–Student Retrieval Learning
bullets: Training a Qwen3-1.7B student against a frozen 4B teacher to learn when to search and what to retrieve under explicit tool-call costs.

Evaluating on controlled fact-finding tasks and MuSiQue multi-hop QA; measuring answer accuracy, retrieval cost, and abstention against standard distillation and information-gain search baselines. Experiments are ongoing; results are not yet available.
